scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @social/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @social/contracts && npm run build --workspace @social/functions
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @social/contracts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulators
scripts.emulators: npm run build && node scripts/run-emulators.mjs start
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:dependencies
scripts.test:emulators:inside: npm run test:rules:inside && npm run test:integration:inside
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build && node scripts/run-emulators.mjs integration
